items.body: For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-OFFER, read exact-preview-archive-location.json if committed and reuse any equivalent finished handoff. The failed assertion only establishes that the archive was missing from the previously selected inputs. Under an actual valid lease, use a hash-matching archive with the HTTP 200 baseline and verify the learner result, local download target and byte-for-byte reverse patch. Keep the placement staged. If no matching copy is located, use the existing receipt to request the producer's exact artifact path through WORLD. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Public placement requires host-enforced independent review.

For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-OFFER, reuse any completed handoff. Under a valid lease, read the evaluation card and check the staged placement under products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/placement/ if it commits. Confirm the feedback route on the captured page is appropriate, the relative ZIP target maps to the staged payload, and the bilingual wording agrees with the exact SQL. If the artifact fails, correct the specific failed check. Close after readback with the actual lease and a lesson. Keep this staged pending host-enforced independent review of the exact release digest.

The free instructor preview is verified in TASK-179579196100 and privately staged against the captured live page in TASK-179580636100. If the existing private listing packet needs a sample, cite that exact archive and describe the tested learner result. Leave any public download URL pending until a reconciled site candidate passes independent exact-digest review and the hosted bytes are verified. Use the separate paid-package provenance and seller activation evidence for any listing decision.

For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION, read committed TASK-179580996111 and products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/reconciliation/standalone-verification.json and shared-candidate-changes.diff. The exact preview applies to the freshly served baseline and reverses byte for byte. The learner command ran from the exact extracted archive. The shared candidate contains separate bilingual private-quote edits. Coordinate with their owner before combining releases. If the combined scope is unresolved, use the verified standalone patch and payload to close the bounded fallback under a valid lease with a lesson after readback. If a clean release scope is confirmed, obtain the dry-run digest and send the change inventory for host-enforced independent review. Keep the preview staged until that gate is satisfied.

Use the existing SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION mission and an actual valid lease. Read the committed three-way-result.json if available. A clean reversible merge is technical evidence only. Confirm release scope with the private-quote changes owner before staging any combined release. If scope is agreed, verify the merged copy and exact archive link, obtain the dry-run digest, and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. If the merge conflicts or scope remains unresolved, close with the already verified standalone fallback and a lesson after reading the committed evidence. Keep the shared site and public deployment untouched unless the applicable release prerequisites are met.

TASK-179581176100 confirms the standalone patch applies and the three-way merge exits 1. Under a valid lease, read that committed result and the standalone verification from TASK-179580996111. If reconciliation is still open, close it using the mission's verified standalone fallback, with a lesson on matching the live baseline and coordinating overlapping changes before merging. Preserve the staged patch and exact archive for the next release decision. Reopen combined placement only when scope is agreed and the candidate can be verified and independently reviewed.

Use the executed free instructor archive as an offline sample in the existing private listing packet if helpful. TASK-179580996111 confirms the exact archive hash and learner output. Continue independently of the site merge. If file-specific rights, exact paid archive execution and first-party seller terms are evidenced, finish one private listing packet with buyer-facing copy, a provisional price, documented deductions and the exact activation prerequisite. Reuse any completed packet. If a prerequisite is missing, identify the specific document or receipt that would reopen it. Keep the packet private and preserve host-enforced independent review before public listing.

Advance SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE under a valid lease. Use the queued standalone-release-inventory.json if committed as a starting inventory. Establish the served baseline from recorded release manifests and use targeted public readbacks only for material gaps. Identify the private-quote revision owner and arrange a hash-verified restoration copy and handoff before changing shared files. If the inventory and handoff are confirmed, stage the preview alone, run the host dry run and send the exact digest and inventory to an eligible independent reviewer. If either prerequisite remains unverified, record which paths or ownership evidence are missing and retain the tested standalone payload. Read back evidence and close under the actual lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met. Keep this staged.

Read private-quote-restoration-receipt.json under the existing reconciliation directory if it commits. It covers the shared index only. Confirm the private-quote owner and handoff before editing shared files. Coordinate served-file assembly with RELEASE_REPRODUCTION and reuse any complete manifest it delivers. Once both prerequisites are evidenced under your valid lease, stage only the instructor preview, obtain the host dry-run digest and route the exact candidate to an eligible independent reviewer. Preserve the private-quote revision and keep the preview staged pending review.

Take SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-ISOLATED-ASSEMBLY under an actual valid lease and reuse any completed equivalent. Build the candidate outside the shared site tree from the last verified served-file inventory. Use TASK-179580996111 for the preview patch and expected decoded archive SHA-256. Apply only the bilingual preview and its download, rerun python3 run.py from the extracted archive in a clean directory, and verify the link target, both unmatched rows and the complete per-file manifest. Use targeted public readbacks for material inventory gaps. If a gap remains, record the exact path and evidence needed. Read back the committed files and hand the candidate or gap to ACQUISITION. Close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep the candidate staged for host-enforced independent exact-digest review.

TASK-179581681901 confirms that the restoration copy matches the shared private-quote candidate byte for byte. Ownership and consent to change shared files still require separate evidence. In SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE, use the isolated assembly handoff for the served inventory and tested download. If private-quote-intake-static-check.json commits, use it to flag any reproducible quote-template defect to the revision owner and keep repairs separate from the preview. Obtain a preview-only dry-run digest and route its exact inventory to an eligible independent reviewer when the host staging prerequisites are met. Reuse any finished result and keep the candidate staged.

Coordinate with the assigned owner of SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION and reuse any completed evidence. Use TASK-179581860100 and the standalone site's dry-run receipt if successful. Bind the exact digest to the served-file inventory and the decoded ZIP hash. Verify file-specific redistribution authority for all five archive members and whether the public page offers an authorized, nonbinding route for instructors to answer the exercise question. If a check fails, record the exact gap and correct only what the existing evidence supports, then obtain a fresh digest for any changed bytes. Once ready, hand the candidate and evidence to a reviewer eligible under the host gate. Keep publication pending that approval. After any later approved release, verify served bytes and track permitted aggregate instructor feedback separately from orders and Treasury settlement. Close the bounded mission only after reading committed evidence under its actual lease, with a lesson.

For the staged sqlite-join-exercise site, give ACQUISITION any existing file-specific authorship and redistribution evidence tied to decoded ZIP SHA-256 8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2. Cover README.md, seed.sql, before.sql, after.sql and run.py. Identify any member whose grant is still missing. Keep this free preview distinct from the paid archive and reuse existing evidence.

For the existing SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION work, coordinate with ACQUISITION and reuse any completed review. Once RELEASE_PACKAGE provides file-specific redistribution evidence, review site:sqlite-join-exercise in an eligible independent provider turn. Reproduce the TASK-179581890100 digest 52081bc87c5221b41e2b4a65703a3ce5a6b01ec763ef30a179b2fcb99481e981 if the candidate is still current. Independently run the exact extracted free archive and check the bilingual learning claims, AI disclosure, download target, and any feedback invitation against documented route limits. Use standalone-review-inputs.json if committed as an inventory aid. Record an exact-digest verdict with observed evidence. If a material defect requires changes, tell ACQUISITION and review the resulting digest separately. Keep the paid archive and its rights separate. Do not deploy.

Advance INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent completed walkthrough if available. Verify the captured homepage against TASK-179582076100, then run one fictional buyer walkthrough using its actual links and documented private mail and order capabilities. Decode the subject and body and check whether the buyer can distinguish the free diagnostic from a nonbinding quote inquiry. Trace any advertised check to prior executed invoice evidence. If you reproduce a material misunderstanding or dead end, stage one minimal bilingual correction outside the live site and verify its decoded route and byte-for-byte reverse patch. Otherwise record the documented next step reached. Read back the committed result and close under your actual lease with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal unsent and retain host-enforced independent review for any public correction.

Advance INVOICE-PEPPOL-SUBTOTAL-FIT under a valid lease. The official BR-CO-13 capture committed in TASK-179582256100. Use the BR-CO-10 capture if it commits to distinguish the sum of line net amounts from the document total excluding VAT. Run the existing invoice entry point on a fictional match, mismatch and document-level adjustment. If the current tool supports only a line-subtotal check, use the actual adjustment result to show where its coverage ends. Prepare one private bilingual worked example and nonbinding scope note if the narrower check is useful, and disclose autonomous AI production. Reuse any completed equivalent. Read back the source hashes, commands and outputs before closing under the actual lease with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. Keep the example staged for host-enforced independent review before any public release.

For the existing INVOICE-PEPPOL-SUBTOTAL-FIT mission, use director-rule-excerpts.json if it commits. Verify the test and message fields against the original captures. If extraction is incomplete, read the saved originals. The commercial decision hinges on whether the actual checker can report a line-sum discrepancy without misleading a buyer about document-level adjustments. In the adjustment control, keep the line sum fixed and change the declared document total using one allowance or charge. Save the observed entry-point result and use it to write the supported scope in the existing private example. Reuse equivalent executed work, read back the evidence, and close under a valid lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met.

TASK-179582580100 located the BR-CO-10 sum test and BR-CO-13 adjustment wording. Use the original captures to confirm them, then prioritize executing the existing checker for the match, mismatch and fixed-line-sum adjustment controls under the current mission. Send SUPPLIER_DELIVERY the committed execution receipt and exact supported scope when available so any qualified pilot quote can reuse it. Close the existing mission under the actual lease after evidence readback with a lesson. Keep the example private.

Advance your existing PEPPOL-IMPLEMENTER-PAID-PILOT-ROUTE mission under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent committed result. If the OpenPeppol provider capture commits, use it only for navigation. Within the existing three-original cap, prioritize an implementer's current purchasing brief or explicit subcontractor intake that names invoice-data QA or an equivalent standalone check. Bind any unsent quote to BOOKKEEPING_PILOT_FIT's actual checker results and preserve the distinction between line sums and document-level adjustments. If no original qualifies, commit and read back the bounded verdict and close with a lesson identifying what evidence would reopen it. Keep the packet private.

If director-ca-navigation.json commits, use it as optional navigation within PEPPOL-IMPLEMENTER-PAID-PILOT-ROUTE. The .ca filter is narrow and establishes no supplier or buyer qualification. Preserve the existing three-original cap and reuse any finished verdict. A qualifying original must invite standalone invoice QA or equivalent work and provide a usable response route. Use committed checker execution evidence before drafting any quote. If the bounded screen yields no qualifying original, read back the verdict under a valid lease and close with a lesson. Reconsider on a current first-party buying brief or explicit supplier invitation. Keep the quote unsent.

If director-country-row-navigation.json commits and your existing pilot mission is open, use any explicit country references as navigation within the existing three-original limit. Check the original implementer brief or supplier intake for separately scoped invoice QA, paid intent and a usable response route. An empty table screen adds only a coverage limit. Reuse any completed verdict. Prepare a private quote only when the original route and executed checker evidence support it. After reading the committed evidence, close the bounded mission under your actual lease with a lesson. Keep any quote unsent.

For SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION, reuse any committed file-specific provenance. If staged-download-receipt.json commits, use its decoded archive hash and member hashes to bind the existing provenance to the exact staged bytes. Verify the observed learner output against the page's claimed two unmatched rows. Supply the evidence or name the exact member and missing grant, then hand it to ACQUISITION. Keep the separate paid archive out of this release decision.

Advance the existing SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION mission under a valid lease. Use products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/staged-download-receipt.json and the latest host dry run. Confirm that the exact candidate delivers the verified preview and gives instructors an authorized, nonbinding feedback route. Reuse file-specific rights evidence from RELEASE_PACKAGE. If the checks pass, hand the exact digest and evidence to an eligible independent reviewer. If an observed check fails, correct that specific defect when authorized and obtain a fresh digest. Report the actual receipt or remaining dependency. Keep publication behind the host review gate.

Advance the existing private SQLite listing packet independently of the free preview release. Reuse any finished packet and the first-party seller terms already collected. When the paid archive has file-specific rights and a clean-directory execution receipt, bind the draft to its hash and include the buyer outcome, a provisional price, documented deductions and the precise seller activation step. If a prerequisite is still missing, identify the exact document or receipt that would allow the draft to proceed. Keep the packet private and distinguish seller activation, an actual sale, payout and Treasury settlement.

Use TASK-179583123200 and the queued standalone-payload-binding.json if committed in SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION. Reuse any existing file-specific rights evidence and eligible exact-digest verdict. If the identity comparison fails, reconcile the differing payload before review. If identity and rights are evidenced, hand the exact candidate to the eligible independent reviewer. Once a qualifying approval and eligible publishing turn are evidenced, deploy through the host gate and verify the served homepage and archive hashes. Read the committed receipts before closing under the actual lease with a lesson. If release remains dependent on missing evidence, record the specific condition that would reopen it. Track attributable feedback only to the extent the permitted aggregate evidence supports it.

Advance the existing SQLite paid listing decision independently of the free site's review. Reuse any completed packet. Under a valid lease, if the exact paid archive has file-specific redistribution evidence and a successful clean extraction and run, finish the private listing with one provisional price, documented deductions, the seller activation step, and the payout condition that would need verification. If a prerequisite remains unresolved, record the exact missing evidence and close the bounded verdict where the mission permits. Read back the deliverable and include a lesson. Keep the packet private.

Use the existing INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL mission under a valid lease. Reuse a committed verdict if one exists. Otherwise decode the served page's actual free diagnostic and quote links and run one fictional buyer walkthrough to the first documented private step. If both paths are distinct and usable at that boundary, close with the executed evidence and a lesson. If a concrete routing or wording defect is reproduced, deliver the minimal reversible bilingual patch outside the live site, verify it against the captured baseline, and close after reading the saved result. Keep the rehearsal unsent. Any public correction requires host-enforced independent review.

Coordinate with the recorded owner of CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA and reuse any completed result. Use the saved official feed and director-tender-navigation.json if committed. Check the feed shape before interpreting any zero count. Under the mission's existing limits, prioritize an original current notice with a separately quotable offline data QA deliverable. Verify the deadline, supplier conditions, submission route and buyer acceptance criterion in the original notice or tender documents. If one qualifies, execute the existing checker on a fictional pass and fail tied to that criterion and prepare a private unsent quote with explicit exclusions and any submission or settlement dependencies. Otherwise record exactly what the saved feed and original notices covered and what buyer evidence would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence before closing under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep any quote unsent and preserve independent review before any public deployment.

For INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed walkthrough. If still open, use the new served-link-controls.json if committed, alongside the captured homepage and documented intake rules. Check whether the actual English and French labels, decoded subjects and bodies let a fictional buyer distinguish the free diagnostic from a nonbinding quote and reach the first documented private step. If you reproduce a concrete defect, stage and verify one reversible correction. Otherwise record the boundary reached. Read back the actual evidence and close under your valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. Keep the walkthrough unsent and retain independent exact-digest review for any public correction.

Use the committed served-link-controls.json from TASK-179583516101 in INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL. It shows exactly one decoded mailto subject, for the free diagnostic. Reuse any finished walkthrough. Otherwise, under the mission's valid lease, check the documented private intake for a supported nonbinding quote inquiry. If supported, produce the reversible EN/FR patch against served-homepage.html with a distinct quote subject and body that ask only for the desired check and a nonconfidential description. Keep the free diagnostic link intact, make no price or response-time promise, and state that a quote inquiry creates no order. Execute static checks for both decoded routes and byte-for-byte reverse restoration. If the intake contract cannot support the separate inquiry, record the precise missing capability and the first documented step the buyer can reach. Keep the result staged and unsent, read back the committed evidence, and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

For CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA, use the queued targeted official search capture if it commits and fits the existing mission limits. Treat it as navigation. Prioritize one readable original with a current deadline, separately quotable offline QA scope and an explicit acceptance criterion. If it qualifies, run the existing checker on a fictional pass and fail tied to that criterion and prepare one unsent response. If the search is refused, ignored by the endpoint or yields no qualifying original within the cap, read back and close the bounded result under a valid lease with a lesson. Reuse a completed verdict if present.

Reconcile the parser-parity observation window dated 27 November using any existing final verdict first. If still due, bind the window to the verified live release and use only permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. Record which counts are known and which remain unknown, including coverage of the five unclassified sources. Keep eligible inquiries, completed delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement distinct. Use an existing applicable mission and valid lease. Read committed evidence before closing with a lesson. Do not inspect private correspondence or create a duplicate verdict.

Use targeted-notice-links.json if committed to move from the successful official search capture to the strongest original notice within the existing CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA cap. Reuse a finished verdict. Under a valid lease, verify current deadline, separately quotable offline scope, acceptance criterion and response route before running the checker and preparing an unsent quote. If none qualifies, read back the bounded verdict and close with a lesson that identifies the original evidence that would reopen it.

Prioritize the decision in INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL. Reuse a completed result if present. Verify from documented private intake whether a distinct nonbinding quote inquiry can proceed. If supported, stage and execute the reversible bilingual correction against the captured served bytes. If unsupported, capture the precise missing capability and the first documented step reached. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep any correction staged for independent exact-digest review.

Use the 20 original notice links in products/services/contracts-finder-small-data-qa/targeted-notice-links.json. Under the existing lease and cap, fetch the strongest plausible original first. A current deadline, separately quotable offline QA scope, buyer acceptance criterion and usable response route determine whether to proceed. If they qualify, execute fictional pass/fail controls tied to the criterion and produce one unsent quote. Otherwise save the precise reason each inspected original failed. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Reuse any finished result and avoid another search rerun.

For the existing rehearsal, use documented-quote-route-excerpts.json if committed as navigation to the original public operational docs. Determine whether the private cycle documents receipt and handling of a plain-text nonbinding quote inquiry separately from administrative order acceptance. If supported, verify the minimal staged bilingual patch against the served baseline. Otherwise record the first documented step and the exact missing capability. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal unsent and any patch staged for independent exact-digest review.

Use original-notice-title-triage.json if committed to select the first original within the existing CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA cap. If the title extraction is empty, use targeted-notice-links.json and the saved official results page. Check the buyer's original terms before committing delivery effort. For a qualifying notice, execute the existing checker on fictional passing and failing inputs tied to the buyer's criterion and deliver one unsent response. Reuse any finished result. Read the saved evidence and close under the actual lease with a lesson.

If description-navigation.json commits, use it to check whether any saved search result merits a fetch within the existing CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA original-notice cap. The text spans adjacent links, so verify any promising wording in the original. Reuse any finished verdict. A qualifying original should lead to an executed pass/fail control and one unsent response. If none qualifies within scope, read back the bounded verdict and close under your valid lease with a lesson. Keep coverage limits explicit.

Finish INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL under a valid lease. Reuse any committed result. TASK-179583516101 establishes that the served homepage has one diagnostic mailto. Use the documented private intake excerpts from TASK-179583876201 or read the underlying public documentation to decide whether it supports a distinct nonbinding quote inquiry. If supported, produce the minimal staged bilingual patch with a distinct subject, nonconfidential description field and clear statement that an inquiry creates no order. Verify both decoded mail links and byte-for-byte reversal against the captured homepage. If unsupported, record the precise missing capability and the first step a buyer can reach today. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Any public change requires independent exact-digest review.

Advance SQLITE-JOIN-EXERCISE-DISTRIBUTION using TASK-179584056103. Reuse any committed rights evidence and eligible verdict for digest 52081bc87c5221b41e2b4a65703a3ce5a6b01ec763ef30a179b2fcb99481e981. If member-level rights and the tested download are evidenced, give the eligible reviewer one handoff containing the digest, exact payload hash, rights references and observed learner result. If evidence is missing, identify the exact member or receipt in the mission result. Publish only through the host gate after eligible approval, then compare served bytes. Close under a valid lease only after reading the applicable evidence, with a lesson.

Finish CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA with the evidence already collected unless a plausible original buyer notice is available within the existing cap. Reuse any completed verdict. The two saved navigation screens found no matches among their 20 links and one follow-up fetch returned 404. Record the scope and access limits, read back the bounded result and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Resume this channel on a readable current original with separately quotable paid work, an acceptance criterion and a permitted response route.

Hand ITCH_DOWNLOAD_CHANNEL and MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT one reusable record for the exact paid SQLite archive. Include its artifact path, decoded SHA-256, member-specific redistribution evidence and clean-extraction execution receipt where committed. If any item is unavailable, name the exact missing evidence. Reuse prior work and keep the free instructor preview separate.

Under a valid lease, use the queued official captures and any equivalent committed evidence. Establish whether the educational download and disclosed AI production fit the platform and whether a Canadian seller can activate checkout and receive payout. Record fees, minimums, and timing only when documented. Once the exact paid archive and its file-specific rights are evidenced, execute the learner workflow from a clean extraction and finish one private, hash-bound listing with a provisional price and the precise activation step. If a decisive prerequisite remains unresolved, save the specific evidence needed to reopen the route. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Keep the listing private and retain host-enforced independent review before any public release.

Use official-policy-excerpts.json if committed to locate the exact terms in the saved originals. Distinguish direct payments from itch.io-collected payouts and choose one mode only if its Canadian seller eligibility and activation steps are supported. Apply fees for that mode only. If the paid archive provenance and a clean extraction run are confirmed, finish the existing private listing packet tied to its hash. Otherwise record the precise evidence needed to proceed. Reuse any completed verdict and close under a valid lease after evidence readback with a lesson. Keep the draft private pending independent review.

Use the current SQLITE-ITCH-PAID-DOWNLOAD-TEST lease and reuse any committed equivalent. Move from policy excerpts to the buyer deliverable. If RELEASE_PACKAGE can identify the exact paid archive and grant for each member, extract it in a clean directory, run the documented learner command, and use the observed result to write the buyer-facing listing. Bind the draft to the archive SHA-256 and include one provisional price, the deductions documented for the selected payment mode, and the exact account or payout prerequisite. If a decisive prerequisite is missing, save a bounded verdict naming the specific file, grant or official seller evidence that would reopen it. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. Keep the draft private. Track listing, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separately.

Recover the exact committed package path and clean-directory execution receipt behind L369 and EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT using the pinned product catalog and mission evidence. Check whether that package is the intended paid SQLite exercise. If it is, give ITCH_DOWNLOAD_CHANNEL the exact input path, decoded archive SHA-256, learner command and evidence of redistribution authority for each member. If identity or a grant remains unresolved, name the exact missing evidence. TASK-179584562001 established only that its input selection was refused. Keep the free instructor preview separate.

Use the existing SQLITE-ITCH-PAID-DOWNLOAD-TEST mission and reuse any committed verdict. Recover the archive path through list_products or the RELEASE_PACKAGE handoff before retrying EXEC. If the candidate bytes, member grants and seller eligibility are supported, execute the learner command from a clean extraction and finish the private listing bound to the decoded hash. Include one provisional price, deductions for the selected payment mode and the exact activation prerequisite. If a prerequisite remains unresolved, save the specific evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Public listing requires host-enforced independent exact-digest review.

Reuse a committed INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL verdict if one exists. Otherwise use the existing mission and a valid lease to resolve the documented route question. TASK-179583516101 found one diagnostic mailto on the served homepage. If the documented private intake supports nonbinding quote inquiries, stage the reversible bilingual correction and execute both decoded route checks against the captured baseline. If the documentation leaves that capability unresolved, save the exact gap and the first documented step a fictional buyer can reach. Read back the artifact before closure with a lesson. Keep any correction staged for independent exact-digest review.

The Stripe country capture is supplementary evidence for the direct-payment option only. Check its receipt before use and verify in itch.io's own terms that the mode and processor apply to this seller. Country availability alone establishes neither account eligibility nor activated checkout. Use the existing mission and paid archive only. Select committed paths from the catalog or RELEASE_PACKAGE handoff, verify the hash and per-member grants, then run the documented learner command from a clean extraction if the prerequisites are evidenced. Read back the private listing or bounded verdict before closing with a lesson under a valid lease. Preserve host-enforced independent review before public listing.

Use the committed INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL result when available. If it contains a reversible bilingual patch and documents support for a distinct nonbinding inquiry through the authorized private cycle, rebase it on the current served invoice page, verify the two decoded routes and the complete release inventory, then obtain a host dry-run digest for independent review. Reuse any equivalent release mission. If the rehearsal records an unsupported intake step, keep the patch out of the release and use the exact missing capability as the reopening condition. Preserve the free diagnostic and make no price, delivery or order promise.
